findings.legacy_count_semantics: count = skip + 1, backed by exact-binary synthetic capability receipt
findings.legacy_owned_child_helper: 15-second timeout, 10-second CPU bound, 64KiB per-file output bound, direct owned-child cleanup and rejection of forced or nonzero completion

implementation_review_requirements: Pin cached executable source bodies before compiling them.
Bind the current resume4 owner, preflight, failure and observer receipts and preserve the historical header/capability evidence.
Hold existing preparation and inspection ownership locks; require recorded processes absent.
Read only sixteen fixed sectors derived from pinned root-header geometry, reject partial reads and preserve sector ordering.
Keep raw JIB bytes on the phone; export only lengths, hashes, allowlisted scalar fields and bounded difference ranges without byte values.
Preserve input, tooling and image identities before and after; distinguish metadata identity checks from a fresh full-disk hash.
Keep all owned native commands reaped, unforced and exit zero before declaring diagnostic completion.
scope_exclusions: No VM, fsck, mount, replay or repair.
No journal-pointer follow or journal content read.
No inspection, application or APK acceptance change.
No new filesystem-health conclusion from a JIB difference.
